Key Findings & Strategic Recommendations

Actionable insights for resellers on model selection, channel strategy, inventory management, and timing.

1. Prioritize High-Margin Models & Colorways

Air Jordan 11 Retro and the Pine Green colorway consistently deliver the highest margins. Focus sourcing on these segments — Air Jordan 11 Retro averages $99.84 margin with 63.4% above-retail rate. Avoid over-investing in Air Jordan 1 Low unless sourcing at significant below-retail prices.

2. Condition Strategy: Source Deadstock When Possible

Deadstock items command a $321.67 margin premium over Used pairs. With 100.0% of Deadstock transactions above retail vs. 0.0% for Used, the probability-weighted expected value strongly favors new product. VNDS offers a viable middle tier at $37.62 average margin.

3. Channel Selection: Balance Margin Against Velocity

Walk-in Retail maximizes per-unit margin ($89.55), while StockX minimizes holding time (7.5 days). For capital-constrained sellers, faster turnover on StockX may yield better annualized returns despite lower per-transaction margins. Large-inventory operators should split listings across channels to optimize both dimensions.

4. Timing & Seasonality

Seasonal margin variation is modest — timing is less critical than product selection and condition. Year-over-year trends show growing market dynamics. Monitor monthly trends to adjust pricing and inventory holding strategies accordingly.

5. Inventory Management

Average days in inventory of 22.5 days across all channels suggests a roughly 0.7-month holding cycle. Deadstock items average 23 days, Used items 23 days. Price aggressively on items exceeding 45 days to free capital for higher-margin opportunities.
